Scientific Survey - Prince Rupert Harbour
An Uncrewed Surface Vessel (USV) will depart from Cow Bay Marina and operate in the Prince Rupert harbour.
The Kaien Xplorer USV is 3.3m long, red and white in colour and is equipped with AIS. 
Hours of operation from 1500UTC Oct 20 to 2330UTC Oct 23.
Call operators at 250-627-2522 for any questions or concerns.
